events.comment: CRACKLINE — Phase 1 prototype. Each system lives in its own external events sheet (Project manager > External events). Order matters: state, movement, spawning, trail, collisions, HUD.
GAME STATE — scene setup, game over overlay and restart. GameState is "Playing" or "GameOver".
Count time spent on the game over screen (prevents a frantic tap from restarting instantly).
Restart: tap/click the RESTART button. Restarting the scene resets every scene variable to its default.
Impact flash fades out and grows.
CRACK MOVEMENT — the crack tip stays at TipScreenY; the world scrolls instead. CrackWorldY = distance travelled upward in px.
One tap = one branch. Taps during a branch or the short cooldown are ignored (no queueing). Left half = left, right half = right.

Lateral offset follows an ease-out curve over BranchDuration, so the branch starts fast (responsive) and lands softly. Position is computed from elapsed time, so the total distance is frame-rate independent. Clamped to the screen so the crack can never get stuck.

parameters: clamp(BranchStartX + BranchDirection * BranchDistance * (1 - pow(1 - BranchTimer / BranchDuration, 2)), EdgeMargin, SceneWindowWidth() - EdgeMargin)
clamp(BranchStartX + BranchDirection * BranchDistance, EdgeMargin, SceneWindowWidth() - EdgeMargin)

events.comment: Place the visual tip and the (hidden) hitbox on the crack's logical position.

OBSTACLE SPAWNER (Phase 1: hand-made chunks). Each chunk is an external layout named Chunk0, Chunk1, ... that is ChunkHeight px tall. Edit them visually in the editor (Project manager > External layouts). Chunk0 is a warm-up; after the last one the sequence loops back to ChunkLoopStart.
Freshly created obstacles: record their logical world position once.

FRACTURE TRAIL — visual only (never tested for collisions). A segment is laid every TrailStep px from the last trail point to the current (slightly jittered) tip position, then scrolls with the world.
Small sparks when the crack changes direction (or breaks). Cheap: a handful of sprites moved by events, deleted after ~0.3 s.
COLLISIONS — only the small hidden CrackHitbox at the tip is tested, against the Obstacles group (simple octagon masks). The trail never collides.
SCORING / HUD — distance is derived from the logical world position (CrackWorldY), not from frame counts.
